# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Native hardening and Uno fixes**

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.3/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.3/index.md)

## Highlights

The 4.155.3 servicing changes backport Skia hardening and fix Uno 6 WebAssembly linking on newer .NET toolchains. This retains the m155 line used by Uno Platform 6 applications without changing public APIs. Native fixes cover shader execution, texture sampling, glyph buffers and GPU resource handling.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Security

- **Skia security backports** — Backports 25 additional Skia CVE fixes and 13 related hardening and test fixes. These address raster-pipeline and allocation overflow, failed uploads, resource lifetimes, glyph bounds, texture-subset sampling and GPU state handling while preserving the m155 engine line and public APIs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5844](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5844))

## Bug Fixes

- **Uno 6 WebAssembly linking** — Uno 6.x applications using the Skia renderer on .NET 9 or later no longer combine Dawn's WebGPU port with the incompatible -sUSE_WEBGPU flag. The flag remains enabled for the .NET 8 toolchain that requires it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
- **Filtered images and GPU drawing** — Native backports prevent unwritten scratch texels from entering mipmapped image-filter output and preserve Graphite painter order after overwriting draws. They also correct reflected hairline caps, text-atlas selection and glyph cropping when scaler state changes between loads. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5844](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5844))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.3

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
